brief.headline: We estimate the 2026 US upland crop at 13.47m bales, 3.2% above USDA's 13.06m.
points: Crop ratings: 33% good/excellent and 37% poor/very poor nationally, against 47% good/excellent a year ago and a 39% five-year average.
Texas: 59% of planted acres expected to be harvested; yield 593 lb vs USDA 535; 48% of the state in D2–D4 drought.
Largest gaps to USDA: Oklahoma 0.42m vs 0.19m; Georgia 2.20m vs 2.00m; Arkansas 1.44m vs 1.60m.
Harvest 23% complete vs 16% last year and 25% on average.
NASS ginnings to First Of Oct (Oct 01, 2026): 0.92m running bales, 6.8% of last season's total (normal 6.9% by this date).
